newsitem.title: USA: Agouron offers AIDS drug in expanded access.
newsitem.headline: Agouron offers AIDS drug in expanded access.

text.p: Agouron Pharmaceuticals Inc said it was making VIRACEPT(TM) available through an expanded access program for people with advanced HIV who have exhausted protease inhibitor treatment options.
The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is providing expanded access for certain investigational drugs in cases where no other comparable or satisfactory therapy exists.

VIRACEPT(TM) is a HIV protease inhibitor. Agouron said it expects to file a New Drug Application with the FDA in the first quarter of 1997, followed by equivalent regulatory submissions in Canada and Europe. An independent European expanded access program will follow later this year.
